title: OntologyConceptDeleteImpact
description: What deleting one ontology concept touches. Relationships and rules are removed together with the concept; blockers must be edited by hand before the concept can be deleted. Catalog bindings are listed by the bindings endpoint.

children.description: Concepts whose named parent is this concept. They keep existing and move to the top level.

relationships.description: Hierarchy and link axioms that name this concept as subject or as a parent or filler.

rules.description: All other axioms that name this concept.

blockers.description: Properties and concepts that point at this concept through a domain, range or replacement.
